label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa contra gentiles I.42…: Diverse things as diverse do not by their own natures…
interpretation: Preserve AS DIVERSE and the source’s explanatory fork. Common intention, coordination and diverse causes acting as a unity require interpretation, rather than being excluded merely by numerical difference. The army/general analogy does not independently establish exhaustiveness or prove every genuine joint cause insufficient. Based on the already verified complete Pegis translation; no pinned Latin reading, formal proof or premise truth is asserted.
